user.title: DMX Config UI
user.description: Adds the **DMX Config** panel to the sidebar. The panel writes the YAML configuration for [DMX]({dmx_url}).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: `{include_file}` was updated. DMX only reads its configuration at startup, so Home Assistant needs to be restarted. The configuration is checked before restarting.

abort.config_invalid:
The configuration is invalid, restart aborted:

{error}

confirm.title: Include the generated file
confirm.description:
`{include_file}` is not referenced in `configuration.yaml`, so Home Assistant will not load it. Submit to set the `dmx:` key to:

`{include_line}`

An existing `dmx:` block is replaced; the previous `configuration.yaml` is saved as `{backup_file}` first ("-" = no block present).
